en.name: Reindsurm Gigalovendra
en.effect: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

zh-CN.name: 轮回虫龙・极巨百足龙
zh-CN.effect:
以“轮回虫龙之骸歌”降临
此卡名的①②③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：在自己・对手回合中，将包含此卡在内的2张手牌送至墓地可以发动。从牌组将炎属性以外的1只“轮回虫龙”怪兽加入手牌。②：此卡仪式召唤的情况下，或对手将怪兽特殊召唤的情况下可以发动。将场上的最多2只怪兽放回牌组。③：自己墓地存在此卡和水属性的“轮回虫龙”怪兽的情况下可以发动。将此卡加入手牌。
